title: Spin-orbital-angular-momentum-coupled quantum gases
method_class: REVIEW: analytic + Gross-Pitaevskii mean-field + Bogoliubov (SOAM cold-atom BEC)
verdict: PARTIAL: single-particle SOAM physics (Sec. III.A, Figs. 2-3) genuinely reproduced from Eq.(17) via finite-difference radial diagonalization (numpy/scipy). C1 (Omega_R=0 spinor-HO limit, degenerate l_z=+/-1 ground state at E=1 hbar_omega) reproduced with analytic cross-check (energy error 0.0). C2 (first-order jump of ground-state QAM from l_z=+/-1 to l_z=0 with increasing coupling at delta=0) reproduced as a discrete no-intermediate jump. C3 (T-symmetry E(l_z)=E(-l_z) at delta=0, violation 0.0; lifted by delta!=0, split 0.323 hbar_omega) reproduced. NOT matched: the paper's ABSOLUTE coupling axis (Omega_R/hw=100,250) -- the review omits the beam waist and Rabi normalization, so our transition sits at Omega_R~8.5 in HO units (missing-parameter gap, not a physics error). Interacting GPE phase diagram, Bogoliubov spectra, and cold-atom experiments left out of scope.
replication_target: single-particle SOAM Hamiltonian Eq.(17); dispersion/degeneracy/symmetry claims of Sec. III.A (Figs. 2-3)
claims_matched: 3/3 (single-particle physics; overall PARTIAL due to unmatched absolute coupling axis + out-of-scope interacting/experimental claims)
compute: CherryRd CPU-only, numpy 2.4.3 + scipy; ~30 s runtime; no GPU, no external data, no paid APIs
compute_target: nuc13 (CPU) first pass; uicgpu if 3D/fine sweeps
